Quantity being confirmed now, as a positive increment added to the line's picked
quantity. Confirming 2 twice on a line of 5 leaves 4 picked.

communicationChannel.description: Channel of communication with the customer. Currently supported values are None, Email and SMS.

phone.description: Customer phone number. Formatted according to E164 standard.

reasonCode.description: Reason code for the service order

serviceItem.description: Details of the item related to service

serviceLocationNo.description: Number of the service location where the service is provided.

technician.description: The technician assigned to the service order.

customerDetails.description: Details of the customer who placed the order.

lines.description: Lines included in the draft order.

CreateDraftOrderRequest.description:

all other fields are optional and may be filled in later.

customerDetails.description: Details of the customer who placed the order

payments.description: Payments registered for the order. Optional.

Required for full orders; optional for drafts.

deliveryProperties.description:

properties.description:

GiftMessage, LoyaltyNumber). Keys must be unique within the collection.

memberNumber.description: Member number used for loyalty point accrual and member-based promotions

deliveryInstructions.description: Special delivery instructions for the order

trackingNumber.description: Tracking number assigned by the carrier

type.description: Delivery type. Possible values: InStore, Mail

discountEffect.description: Describies how the discount is applied: as a percentage, as an amount or as a direct amount

discountType.description: The type of the discount: Line, Subtotal, Group, CustomerGroup, ArticleBundle, Model, MemberPrice, CampaignPrice

each fulfilled by a single store.

lines.description: Allocated lines of the fulfillment order.

pickListIds.description:

can navigate straight to its picking work without polling the pick list endpoint.

status.description: Fulfillment (picking) status. A cancelled fulfillment order has `Status = Cancelled`.

storeNumber.description: Store number of the fulfilling store.

FulfillmentOrderLine.description: A line of a fulfillment order, referencing an order line and the quantity allocated to it.

orderLineNo.description: Line number of the referenced order line.

quantityAllocated.description: Quantity of the order line allocated to this fulfillment order.

discount.description: The details of the discount applied to the related order line. Optional.

itemIdentifier.description: Identifier of the item that line accords to. Required.

deliveryInstructions.description: Special delivery instructions for the order

dueAmount.description: Amount still due on the order (TotalAmount minus PaidAmount)

fulfillmentOrders.description: Fulfillment orders (units of picking) for this order. Created when the order becomes Active.

orderStatus.description: Order status as a string (e.g. Active, Cancelled, Done, Draft)

paidAmount.description: Amount already paid on the order

paymentStatus.description: Payment status as a string (e.g. NotPaid, PartiallyPaid, Paid, OverPaid, NotApplicable)

GiftMessage, LoyaltyNumber).

discountDetails.description: The details of the discount applied to the related order line

itemIdentifier.description: Identifier of the item that line accords to

discountDetails.description: The details of the discount applied to the related order line

itemIdentifier.description: Identifier of the item that line accords to

direction.description: Direction of the transaction. Optional. Possible values: In (payment), Out (refund)

transactionType.description: Type of transaction. Optional. Possible values: Authorization, Capture, Sale, Credit, Void

PickList.description:
A pick list: the unit of picking work for a fulfillment order. Returned by the work-discovery
list endpoint and by the start/confirm actions, carrying progress, eligibility and its lines.

cancellationReason.description: Why the pick list was cancelled, when its status is Cancelled.

completedDate.description: When the pick list was completed.

confirmedLineCount.description: Lines whose picked quantity has reached the quantity to pick.

createdDate.description: When the pick list was created.

eligibleAt.description:
Picking may not start before this moment (anti-race delay). Filter server-side
via OData, e.g. `$filter=EligibleAt le 2030-01-01T09:00:00Z`.

fulfillmentOrderId.description: The fulfillment order this pick list was generated for.

isEligible.description:
True when the eligibility delay has elapsed and picking may start. Convenience flag
computed at read time; not OData-queryable (filter on CustomerOrderV2.Contracts.Gateway.Common.PickList.EligibleAt instead).

lines.description: The lines to pick. Included so clients can discover line ids for confirmation.

orderNumber.description: The parent order number this pick list belongs to.

progress.description: Pick progress ratio: confirmed lines / total lines (0 when there are no lines).

startedBy.description: Who started picking, once it has been started.

status.description: Lifecycle status of the pick list.

storeNumber.description: The store the pick list is to be picked at.

totalLineCount.description: Total number of lines on the pick list.

PickListLine.description: A single line on a pick list: what to pick and how much has been picked so far.

id.description: Pick list line identifier, used to address line confirmation.

isFullyPicked.description: True when the picked quantity has reached the quantity to pick.

itemText.description: Human-readable item description, snapshot at pick list generation.

mainGTIN.description: Main GTIN, snapshot at pick list generation.

orderLineNo.description:

correlation key back to the order (SKUs may repeat across lines).

pickedBy.description: User who last picked this line, if any.

pickedDate.description: When this line was last picked, if ever.

quantityToPick.description: Quantity that should be picked for this line.

sku.description: Stock keeping unit, snapshot at pick list generation.

PickListStatus.description: Lifecycle status of a pick list.

($filter, $orderby, $select, $top, $skip); the server pages the result at 100 items unless
a smaller $top is given. Sorting is limited to Id, CreatedDate, EligibleAt, Status and

progress and whether the pick list is eligible for picking yet. An invalid status name is
rejected as 400 (RFC 7807 model-state body); an out-of-range numeric status or an unknown
store is rejected as 422.
